description: 六类胜负证据：VP批次、军事延后、扣留审核、核战、地区与最终计分；最终正负零/欧洲优先已实现，最终宿主和特殊卡终局待接。
inputs: 六种封闭类型证据之一；军事/DEFCON/地区证据来自实际只读计划或结果
权威双方是否扣留计分牌的布尔审核结果
outputs: 只读VictoryDecision：绝对SignedVp、Continue/Deferred/Finished/UnresolvedAdjudication、赢家或军事Pending、来源与矩阵行ID
最终计分零分为Finished且Winner=null；普通零分不因此终局

dependencies.relation: 只读地区结果的净VP/欧洲信号
同一快照完整六区与中国牌结果

preconditions: 调用方已确认检查点完整及规则资格
服务只计算，不提交GameState；有限试玩宿主已接顺序/幂等/终局吸收，完整整局和存档另行实现
普通/军事/地区/最终批次前VP必须在自动胜利线内；审核Pending须来自同一定义
side_effects: 纯计算，无状态写入、随机数、文件或UI依赖
stop_conditions: 损坏/缺失/重复矩阵条件与不合法采用状态
整数溢出或批次前VP已到终局线
未采用裁定返回UnresolvedAdjudication，无赢家；不当作平局
特殊卡结束没有本批证据入口；最终计分宿主资格仍须调用方校验

rule_sources.description: WG1: Sections 5.2, 10.2, 10.3.1: successful event disposition, signed VP and complete-event automatic victory. Section 10.3.2 zero draw literally follows final scoring; not a dedicated Wargames ruling. DF1: Sections 4.5C, 5.2, 6.4.5, 10.2-10.3: ordinary headline ordering, opponent-event controller and order, no event from Space, complete VP batch automatic victory. DV1: PDF p4 4.5C-D ordinary alternating slots; p5 5.2/5.4/5.5; p7 6.4.1 Operations-valued Space eligibility; p8 8.1.3; p10 10.2.3/10.3.1 SHA256: d5c827cf78fc4800e0993c1e3313ec909d3c7da2c1b03b735ccf0042a0c4ac8e

WG1: PDF p17-18 #100: no final scoring; only used at DEFCON 2; three choices give six and end, give six and continue, or neither. No dedicated zero-result answer in this block. DF1: PDF p1 nonstar erratum; p18 #103 USSR selected headline self-cancels with zero VP, US selected Defectors overrides higher Soviet Ops, nested cannot undo an executed headline; p14 #67 Grain Sales actual order. Visually inspected PDF p15 English #100: Neutral, 4 Ops, Late, starred; DEFCON 2; give opponent 6 VP then may end without Final Scoring. DF1: Personally viewed PDF p6 #103: US2 Early nonstar; headline cancels USSR headline including Scoring, canceled card discarded; Soviet ActionRound use US1VP except Space. DV1: English images PDF p8 #50 and p10 #60 personally inspected; adjacent translation excluded SHA256: 3fded13f03c63154de72af93faceaf8700db19f12c033ff477497232f2c2a0f0

WG1-DERIVED-01: DEFCON 2 DeclineBoth counts as used and removes by FAQ used condition plus section 5.2, not a dedicated disposal answer. Nonzero Wargames winner follows accepted signed-VP comparison. Zero GiveSixAndEnd is now separately governed by PROJECT-WG1-USER-20261013; other source/cleanup boundaries remain. Source/receipt/atomic cleanup are planned contracts.

Typed priority plan, cancellation/success records, source/root cleanup and immutable historical receipts are design contracts. Unknown nested providers including Grain Sales require a separately verified contract; the FAQ timing fact alone is not authorization.
2026-10-13 finite prefix/checkpoint/accepted-UN/receipt contract. No official U2 repeated-use or WWBY self-activation/Trap/cross-turn timing ruling adopted.
GiveSixAndEnd向对手完整转移6VP并结束后，恰零判Draw；不是官方专门裁定。 Verified仅表示本线程用户明确确认，非官方专门裁定；不扩大其它未答项目解释。

planned_inputs: 已完成检查点、规则证据、VP批次与责任上下文
不可变规则定义及版本绑定
